verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an e-signature product, since self-hostable alternatives exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Docusign can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. The evidence covers only the cloud service, client SDKs, OpenAPI specs and a vendor-run MCP server, none of which amount to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
